start: Owner online, member app on, Shop, no products yet

user_sees: Title 'Shop', 'What members order in the MettleUp app, and what you sell'
'No products yet' 'Add what you sell at the desk, like protein, shakers and T-shirts. Members can then order them in the app.'
must_not: Sample products in a real gym

steps.action: Add a product with name, price and stock, 'Members can see and order this' on; add a photo
user_sees: The product in the list with its stock
Toast 'Photo added to <name>. Members see it in the app now.'
must_not: A product saved with an empty name or price ('Please fix the boxes marked in red.')
The photo of another product

steps.action: A member orders it in the app; open Orders
user_sees: Tab 'Orders · 1 new'
The order card with lines and 'Total'
must_not: The order missing until a reload when 'New orders show up here on their own in a few seconds.'
Stock not reduced

user_sees: Toast 'Order <no> is ready. <member> can see this in the app.'
Toast 'Order <no> collected. ₹<total> taken.'
Today's shop card counts it
must_not: Cash taken when the member paid online a moment ago (the desk must be told not to take it)
The sale counted twice in today's card

start: Owner taps the shop card on Today, or the new-order alert

steps.action: Tap today's shop card or the alert
user_sees: Shop opens on Orders with the new order on top
must_not: The products tab instead
An order of another branch

steps.action: On a product tap 'Add 10 to stock'
user_sees: Toast 'Added 10 to <name>. <n> in stock now.'
must_not: 20 added from a double tap

start: Owner on Shop, things that must be refused

steps.action: Save a product with no name or a price of 0
user_sees: 'Please fix the boxes marked in red.'
must_not: A free or nameless product shown to members

steps.action: Edit a product another device deleted meanwhile
user_sees: 'This product was deleted while you were editing it.'
must_not: The product re-created silently

steps.action: Open Shop in a gym whose member app is off
user_sees: The card to turn on the member app first
must_not: An order list that can never fill, with no reason

user_sees: Sheet 'Cancel order <no>?' with 'Keep it'
After confirming: toast 'Order <no> cancelled. Stock is back.'
must_not: Stock not put back
A paid online order cancelled with no word about the money
The member not told in the app

steps.action: Mark a ready order back to new
user_sees: Toast 'Order <no> is back to new.'
must_not: The order lost from both filters

steps.action: Hide a product, then show it; then delete it
user_sees: 'Hidden — members can’t see it' then 'Members can see and order this'
Delete: 'It goes from the app at once. Old orders for it stay as they are. …'
must_not: Old orders losing their line text after the delete
A hidden product still orderable

steps.action: A member cancels the own order in the app
user_sees: The card says 'Cancelled by member'
must_not: Shown as cancelled by the gym

start: Owner looks at an order card

user_sees: The member's name, what was ordered, the total
must_not: Orders of another gym
The member's payment details beyond paid or not
